procedure: Black calibration, white calibration, then the same black patch read once.
inference_method: raw = black + normalized_input * (white - black); all three normalized values are strictly between 0 and 1, so inversion is unaffected by clipping.
interpretation: Black reference and subsequent black reading differ before neural inference. Movement of sensor itself is excluded by the user report; cause is not yet isolated.
next_check: Stationary black-white-black raw readings at several LED settling delays, without neural inference.
